bio: The Portmeirion Hotel has been welcoming guests to the Italianate Village of Portmeirion since 1926. Portmeirion Village – built by Welsh Architect Sir Clough Williams-Ellis is one of North Wales’s biggest attractions, welcoming over 250-thousand-day visitors a year. The Hotel building, where afternoon tea is served is on the waters edge and overlooks the Dwyryd Estuary.  The Hotel Portmeirion serves Afternoon Tea in the lounges and restaurant between 14:30pm - 15:30pm, Monday to Saturday. All pre-booked Portmeirion afternoon tea reservations include complementary entry into Portmeirion village after 12:00. Served in either the Hotel Lounges or Art Deco Restaurant designed by Terance Conran.  The Afternoon Tea menu consists of sweet and savoury treats. The menu changes regularly allowing the freshest of seasonal ingredients to be used. The Afternoon Tea is priced at £36 per person and includes complementary entry into the village from 12:00.
